dedupe_keys.name: nairobi and istanbul multi hazard interrelationships database

description: Robert Šakić Trogrlić and colleagues publish a literature-based database of natural hazards and their interactions in Nairobi and Istanbul. Zenodo provides an Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0 at no cost; a separate PDF readme describes its tabs. The team reviewed 135 sources and listed evidence for 19 potential hazard types in Nairobi and 23 in Istanbul, including possible triggering or probability-increasing pairs. A modeller can use the pair descriptions to choose multi-hazard sequences for infrastructure disruption scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this city-pair evidence table. A limitation is that it compiles reported possibilities, not measured annual frequencies or a calibrated causal network. The authors’ source selection and evidence definitions govern how strong each relation is; the workbook must not be treated as a complete list of future events. The workbook and PDF were not downloaded, and individual source claims were not independently checked.
